newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK XIOSBANK TO TRADE WITH 20PCT LIMIT-COMMISSION.
newsitem.headline: GREEK XIOSBANK TO TRADE WITH 20PCT LIMIT-COMMISSION.

text.p: Greece's capital markets commission set a 20 percent price volatility limit for new listing Xiosbank in its first three days of trading, effective Tuesday, it said in a statement.
Trading in the Athens bourse was cancelled on Monday due to technical problems related to overwhelming buying interest for Xiosbank, bourse officials said.
Shares of Xiosbank hit the upper 20 percent limit at open on Tuesday, trading at 3,180 drachmas, up from the IPO price of 2,650 drachmas.
There was open buy interest for around 592,000 shares at 3,180 drachmas. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
